packet is classified as AIVDM_PACKET and handed to the downstream AIS decoder."},{"step":8,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":3210,"var":"packet_type","code":"switch (packet_type) { ... case AIVDM_PACKET: ...","note":"The recognized packet type selects the AIS decode path, which consumes fields derived from the attacker-controlled sentence."},{"step":9,"file":"gpsd/packet.c","function":"packet_parse","line":3210,"var":"decoder sink","code":"AIS/AIVDM decode and field extraction in the packet-type dispatch","note":"The uninitialized read during decode."}]
